three_joined_four_knot_rings.scope: A positive control for the split test, with a move bound that admits no nonzero changes. The forced sum is already present at the source. The control is outside the study census.

method_note: A class label is any nonconstant binary linear invariant modulo the laws. Unread counts exclude the union of the individual knots' readable subspaces. Cycles in forced sums are simple, distinction-disjoint when split, and use only twice-held distinctions. Class label denominators alone neither require nor imply a cycle carrier. A distinction can contribute repeatedly across different splits and sums, while the distinct-cycle counts are summed over stages after deduplication within each stage. The witness row for the 240th accepted seven-knot draw repeats the held-out row through round two.
